record.original_question: Establish non-trivial lower bounds for the generic stabilizer rank stabR_d (the least r such that the relevant symmetric space lies in the span of r stabilizer states).

evidence.quote: Problem 24. Determine non-trivial lower bounds on stabRd .

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $n\ge 1$ and consider the $n$-qubit Hilbert space $\mathcal{H}_n=(\mathbb{C}^2)^{\otimes n}$. A stabilizer state in $\mathcal{H}_n$ is a unit vector (up to scalar) of the form $U|0\rangle^{\otimes n}$ where $U$ is an element of the $n$-qubit Clifford group; equivalently, it is a joint eigenvector of a maximal abelian subgroup of the Pauli group on $n$ qubits. Denote by $\mathrm{Stab}_n\subset\mathbb{P}(\mathcal{H}_n)$ the (finite) set of stabilizer states. For a vector $v\in\mathcal{H}_n$, the stabilizer rank of $v$ is
$$\chi(v)=\min\Bigl\{r\;:\;v=\sum_{i=1}^r c_i\,s_i,\ c_i\in\mathbb{C},\ s_i\in\mathrm{Stab}_n\Bigr\}.$$

Now fix a degree $d\ge 1$ and consider instead the space $S^d\mathbb{C}^m$ of symmetric tensors of order $d$ on $\mathbb{C}^m$, embedded in the appropriate $n$-qubit (or qudit) tensor space via the standard symmetrization. Define the generic stabilizer rank
$$\mathrm{stabR}_d := \min\bigl\{r\;:\; \text{a generic point of } S^d\mathbb{C}^m \text{ lies in the linear span of } r \text{ stabilizer states}\bigr\},$$
i.e. the least integer $r$ such that the $r$-th secant-like variety obtained as the linear span of $r$ stabilizer states fills (a Zariski-dense subset of) the symmetric space.

Problem. Establish non-trivial lower bounds on $\mathrm{stabR}_d$ as a function of $d$ (and $m$); in particular, prove a lower bound that grows faster than any bound obtainable from elementary dimension-counting arguments.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of obtaining non-trivial lower bounds on stabilizer rank (including its generic/asymptotic forms) remains an active area of research. Recent works (Peleg–Shpilka–Volk 2021; Labib 2022; Lovitz–Steffan 2022; Mehraban–Tahmasbi 2023) have established lower bounds of the form Ω(n) for n-fold tensor products of single-qubit magic states and quadratic lower bounds for approximate stabilizer rank, but the question of non-trivial lower bounds for the generic stabilizer rank in the symmetric setting is still considered open.

status_evidence.title: Lower Bounds on Stabilizer Rank (Peleg-Shpilka-Volk)
status_evidence.snippet: Lower bound of Ω(n) on the stabilizer rank of n-fold tensor powers of single-qubit magic states, improving previous Ω(√n).
status_evidence.claim: State of the art lower bounds remain linear; generic case largely open.

status_evidence.title: New techniques for bounding stabilizer rank (Lovitz-Steffan)
status_evidence.snippet: Algebraic-geometric techniques recovering known lower bounds up to log factors.
status_evidence.claim: Generic stabilizer rank framework introduced; non-trivial lower bounds remain a target.

status_evidence.title: Quadratic Lower bounds on the Approximate Stabilizer Rank
status_evidence.snippet: Quadratic lower bounds for approximate stabilizer rank via probabilistic methods.
status_evidence.claim: Active progress, exact problem still open.
